primary_source_check.status: PrimaryNIST abstract independently inspected; cure-history sensitivity is prior art, full component-specific validation absent.

reliability.rationale: The preselected mixture reduces held-out20K/min conversion MAE to0.0589466 versus0.0752806 domain and0.0836005 flexible. This is one independent thermal history, not501 independent experiments.

mechanism.rationale: Two Arrhenius-weighted channels are a bounded phenomenological representation. Parameter exchangeability, rate/energy compensation, Jacobian conditioning and only four training programs prevent chemical-species identification.

novelty.rationale: Targeted primary-source context and established equation families do not establish global novelty. No independent expert/literature adjudication performed.

significance.rationale: Useful compact transfer benchmark for one faster ramp; isothermal, multistep and batch transfer remain untested.

reproducibility.rationale: Native parser, equations, frozen coefficients, predictions and grouping contracts are explicit and inspected. Full independent executable testing belongs to the separate computational review.

impact.rationale: No intervention, deployed savings, reliability qualification or independent experiment demonstrates industrial impact.
